name: SWT-Bench Lite
description: A focused 276-instance subset of SWT-Bench for fast evaluation of test-generation agents. Models must generate unit tests that reproduce real GitHub bugs — failing before the canonical patch, passing after — across 12 popular Python repositories. Mirrors the design of SWE-bench Lite as a cost-efficient evaluation split.
evaluation_method: success rate (tests fail before patch, pass after); coverage increase (ΔC) on resolving patch
general_score_metric: success rate 𝒮 (% of issues reproduced); coverage increase ΔC
typical_sota_score: ~89% (DevstralTestGen by Mistral AI, reproduction script mode, 2025); ~56% unit-test mode (ReProAgent); ~18.5% (SWE-Agent+)
reputation: NeurIPS 2024; standard fast-eval split of SWT-Bench; mirrors SWE-bench Lite in scope and usage; leaderboard at swtbench.com
notes: 276-instance subset of SWT-Bench Full. BM25 retrieval provides 27k-token context (cl100k_base). Two prompt formats hosted on HuggingFace: eth-sri/SWT-bench_Lite_bm25_27k_zsb and eth-sri/SWT-bench_Lite_bm25_27k_zsp. Mirrors the SWE-bench Lite philosophy of balancing evaluation speed with representativeness. arXiv: 2406.12952.

institutions: ETH Zurich (SRI Lab — Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems Lab)
